turns.question: Which customer opened the most CRM emails between 20 September and 3 October 2026, and how many did they open?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric or dimension that ranks individual customers, so I cannot say which customer opened the most CRM emails. The closest metrics are customer_actions (filtered to action type email_open) and engaged_customers_7d / engaged_customers_28d, which can give email opens in total or by customer country or day, but not per customer.
